boundary: Independent static source/metadata-delta/hash and synthetic receipt-parser review only. No SQL or production operation executed by this reviewer. Native PostgreSQL evidence below was produced by the separate SQL agent with synthetic data and an explicit fixture-only BASE adaptation.

checks.name: exact_body_delta
checks.detail: Only the search allowlist and employment predicate differ from the accepted search definition; inverse replacement restores every byte.

checks.name: search_only_before_pagination
checks.detail: employment excludes task and includes NULL; all/task/exact-subtype branches retain prior behavior; predicate precedes cursor and limit.

checks.name: target_metadata_preserved
checks.detail: Owner, direct ACL, security-definer, language, stability, strictness, parallel/leakproof flags, return type, argument names/defaults and config are identical; only body hash changes.

checks.name: accepted_input_pins
checks.detail: All five accepted source/catalog input hashes match; accepted commit/tree/file-count are explicit pins, not a claim of freshly read production state.

checks.name: sql_files_manifest
checks.detail: Every listed SQL file matches sql-files.json.

checks.name: receipt_fingerprints
checks.detail: Independent local JSONB-style serialization reproduces the three published SHA256 fingerprints.

checks.name: preflight.sql_catalog_identity
checks.detail: Every embedded catalog recognition block is byte-identical to catalog-query.sql.

checks.name: apply.sql_catalog_identity
checks.detail: Every embedded catalog recognition block is byte-identical to catalog-query.sql.

checks.name: verify.sql_catalog_identity
checks.detail: Every embedded catalog recognition block is byte-identical to catalog-query.sql.

checks.name: transaction_and_acknowledgement
checks.detail: One guarded replacement is checked within the write transaction; COMMIT occurs before a new read-only snapshot checks afterstate and emits acknowledgement.

checks.name: independent_verify
checks.detail: Separate verification requires exact afterstate in a read-only transaction; preflight also uses read-only/ROLLBACK and unknown is not trusted.

checks.name: only_one_function_replacement
checks.detail: Only search_public_jobs_v1 is replaced; no row DML, table/policy/role/ACL changes or extra function creation is present. Transactional/advisory locks and SET LOCAL bounds are intentional.

checks.name: visibility_and_write_gates_pinned
checks.detail: Accepted publication/account-availability/block/hide gates and projection/cursor remain in search; current writer/account dependencies are additionally pinned and unchanged.

checks.name: metadata_only_recognition
checks.detail: Catalog recognition queries pg_catalog metadata and privilege expressions; no application/Auth/account/Storage rows are selected or exported.

checks.name: receipt_parser_strictness
checks.detail: Independently exercised four valid and five invalid synthetic receipt envelopes. Rejects uncommitted/before apply and verify, wrong read-only flag, drifted fingerprint and non-boolean recognition. This is not SQL execution.

limitations: The live catalog must still match exact production BASE and BEFORE pins at install time. No fresh production observation was made here.
The native fixture substitutes hosted Auth/Storage/avatar boundaries and adapts only test BASE; production target BEFORE/AFTER metadata remains exact.
This review does not claim browser layout or live deployment verification.
